rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCPShield is a security-focused reverse proxy that sits between MCP clients and servers, providing real-time monitoring and enforcement of security policies. It detects prompt injection attempts, filters sensitive data from tool call responses, and blocks unauthorized outbound requests. The platform supports custom rule definitions and provides audit logging for compliance and incident response.
